verdict.rationale: First-party Microsoft 365 docs confirm a built-in AI assistant, Copilot Chat, inside Teams that can work with web and work data from Microsoft Graph and Work IQ. The evidence shows only chat-style interaction, not actually handing off tasks for the assistant to carry out. The Teams agent and slash-command docs describe developer-built agents rather than a native assistant. Missing for 10: documented task delegation and execution by the built-in assistant, detail on which in-Teams actions Copilot can perform, and independent or hands-on confirmation of Copilot in Teams.
